project.name: Arqvia
project.productType: Premium architecture, construction and interiors lead-generation website with a private operations CMS

design.colorMode: mixed editorial: dark graphite proof surfaces with light paper content bands

typography.display: Newsreader, medium weight, editorial and compact
typography.body: Manrope, regular to semibold, highly legible

spacing.public: spacious editorial bands with 20px mobile and 32px desktop gutters

design.density: editorial public site; compact operational admin

preferredPrimitives: native details/summary where responsive visibility is not required
patterns: full-bleed image hero with left editorial copy

must: Keep the Arqvia name and Spanish/English language support
Keep the hero image clean and visually dominant
Use clear conversion actions on every major public page
Preserve keyboard navigation, visible focus, reduced motion and 44px touch targets
Keep before/after images from the same room and comparable viewpoint
Keep admin surfaces utilitarian, role-aware and private
avoid: Public copy containing template, demo, editable, placeholder or internal implementation language
Background grids, architectural line overlays or callout lines over the hero image
Pointer-driven hero parallax, shine sweeps or aggressive animation
Nested decorative cards and rounded pill-heavy UI
Decorative gradients, orbs and visual effects without a functional role

decisions.decision: Keep the current premium architecture direction and refine behavior instead of redesigning stable public sections.
decisions.evidence: Five-width screenshot baseline, zero home Axe violations and no horizontal overflow.

decisions.decision: Show the floating mobile conversion bar only after the opening content and hide it near the footer.
decisions.evidence: The always-visible bar obscured portfolio content and duplicated hero/footer actions.

decisions.decision: Collapse secondary admin panels on mobile while retaining the complete desktop dashboard.
decisions.evidence: Authenticated mobile dashboard measured 12,626px before prioritization.
